name: pyamg_ruge_stuben_solve
summary: Given a freshly generated 2D Poisson sparse matrix A and a random right-hand side b, build an algebraic-multigrid solver and return x that solves Ax=b to a tight tolerance.

name: zodipy_dirbe_emission
summary: Given a wavelength/frequency, sky coordinates, and an observation time, compute the zodiacal light emission intensity (in MJy/sr) for a solar-system observer, reproducing the reference DIRBE Zodiacal Light Prediction Software.

name: pybox_gas
summary: Given the MCM alpha-pinene chemical mechanism file and initial conditions (O3=18 ppb, APINENE=30 ppb, 298.15 K, RH 0.5, noon), auto-generate and integrate the gas-phase ODE system to produce the time evolution of species concentrations, showing alpha-pinene decay and pinonic-acid (PINONIC) formation over a 3-hour simulation.

name: scikit_topt_oc
summary: Given a small 3D box mesh with fixed boundary + point load (generated by the library's own toy_problem helpers), run the Optimality-Criteria topology optimizer and produce an optimized material-density field whose structural compliance is driven down while the volume fraction is held at its target.

name: ssalib_sst_ssa
summary: Given the shipped monthly Sea Surface Temperature series (load_sst), run Singular Spectrum Analysis to decompose it and reconstruct trend and seasonality components, reproducing the README headline decomposition figure.
notes: re-verified True after interpret_smoke fix (sci-notation parse + deviation-metric direction); was a false-negative runs-unverified

name: despasito_saft_gamma_mie_propane_saturation
summary: Given SAFT-γ Mie group parameters for propane (2×CH3 + 1×CH2), predict its saturation properties (vapor pressure and coexisting liquid/vapor densities) across a temperature grid and reproduce the shipped experimental saturation curve.
notes: re-verified True after interpret_smoke fix (sci-notation parse + deviation-metric direction); was a false-negative runs-unverified

name: pysrurgs_symbolic_regression
summary: Given a small numeric CSV of (x,y) points, run uniform random global search and output a symbolic equation of best fit whose predictions match the data with high R^2.

name: disruptionpy_mast_shot
summary: Given one open-access MAST shot number, retrieve its physics signals over the public STFC S3/Zarr store and assemble a disruption-analysis xarray Dataset on a common timebase (plasma current, q95, density, Greenwald fraction, etc.).
notes: two-list verifier abstains on peak_plasma_current_amps direction; value 654488 A clears the 100000 A floor (genuine revival, verification inconclusive)

name: matador_kp_convex_hull
summary: Given a directory of DFT structure files (.res), build the binary convex hull (phase diagram) of the K-P system and compute each structure's energy distance above the hull.
Given a date range and a small area-of-interest, build a Landsat surface-reflectance collection via RadGEEToolbox and compute a per-pixel NDVI image, then reduce it to a mean NDVI value over the AOI.

name: ahg_estimate
summary: Given the shipped USGS field-measurement time series (Q, Y, V, TW) for gage 01096500 on the Nashua River, fit a mass-conserving at-a-station hydraulic geometry system via the ensemble (OLS/NLS/NSGA-2 evolutionary) solver and return power-law exponents/coefficients for width, depth, and velocity.

name: w2w_lcz_to_wrf
summary: Given a WRF geo_em domain file and a WUDAPT LCZ GeoTIFF, produce the three modified WRF domain NetCDF files (NoUrban, LCZ_extent, LCZ_params) that inject LCZ-derived urban canopy parameters into the WRF grid.
